_about: The removing-conditions (I-751) packet (src/packet.py, src/conditions.py), per the I-751 Instructions (04/01/24): the G-28 and the I-751, the 2-year green card (front and back) of the client and of each child included, evidence the marriage was entered in good faith, and for a waiver the divorce decree or death certificate, or the evidence of abuse or hardship. No photos unless living overseas on military or government orders. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: I-751 petition (removing conditions on residence)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: No photos unless the client lives overseas on military or government orders (then two for each petitioner and child).
A joint petition: the client's spouse signs Part 8 too. USCIS rejects it unsigned.

exhibits.title: Copy of the 2-year Permanent Resident Card (front and back), and each included child's
Evidence of a good-faith marriage: joint lease or mortgage, joint bank accounts, joint tax returns, insurance, children's birth certificates, photographs, affidavits
How the marriage ended (divorce or annulment decree, or death certificate)
Evidence of abuse or extreme hardship (waiver)
Court dispositions for every arrest or charge (Part 1, 20)
